source: SYNTHESISED. Cluster point locations, sizes, dates, durations and FRP are modelled, not observed. They are drawn around named real fire-prone landscapes and rescaled so the area_ha total reconciles to burned_area_mha_kalimantan for 2009 in seasons.json. Provincial shares interpolate between the two located KLHK per-province recaps (2019 El Nino and 2022 La Nina) using that year's peak Aug-Nov ONI. Deterministic: seeded with 20260918+year.
caveats: These are not fire detections. Do not read an individual dot as a real fire.
Only the annual area total and the provincial split are tied to published statistics.
For genuine per-fire records use NASA FIRMS (VIIRS/MODIS active fire) or MCD64A1 burned-area products.
